author: gobernment
body:
Another grounded KoTH map, except with a unique concept: everyone's on one side. Consider it experimental more than anything. :)

Building is allowed in all forms except a small radius around the hill. This is exclusively for Atlas, so therefore XML/YML will not be made until further notice. CPS in title = Capture Points, not Clicks per second.




One Hill:
- Center (Main hill)

Thanks to alexanderjoe to hosting the server.

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
The concept is very innovative and I really like it, but I suggest making it so you die when you capture to prevent allies camping. Also, maybe change the oak wood with other wood blocks dotted around as it's a bit plain when you're looking at it through pictures.
Nice job!
